scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks || echo hk: not a git repository - pre-commit hook not installed
scripts.check:fast: next typegen && tsc --noEmit && eslint . && node scripts/check-secrets.mjs && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:fast && node scripts/check-rls.mjs && node scripts/check-honesty.mjs && node scripts/check-assets.mjs && vitest run --passWithNoTests && next build && node scripts/check-dynamic.mjs && playwright test
scripts.check:release: npm run check && node scripts/verify-lock.mjs && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && node scripts/check-weight.mjs && node scripts/check-opennext.mjs && node scripts/check-licences.mjs && node scripts/check-chunks.mjs && node scripts/facts.mjs
